# Domain model and glossary documentation

When adding or changing an entity, DTO, mapper, enum, use case, repository, database entity, or business rule:

1. Update docs/domain-model.md for entity, relationship, lifecycle, or business-rule changes.
2. Update docs/glossary.md when introducing a new project-specific term, module, entity, or abbreviation.
3. Keep definitions concise and linked to the relevant module where possible.
4. Do not include full class definitions or implementation code.
